title: Valneva to Participate at U.S. and European Investor Conferences in June
summary: Lyon (France), May 28, 2026 – Valneva SE (Nasdaq: VALN; Euronext Paris: VLA), a specialty vaccine company, today announced that its senior management will present and hold investor meetings at several upcoming investor conferences in the United States and Europe in June 2026.
